availability: Free · needs a Ledge with LedgeKit 0.21 and Claude Code · macOS 14 or later
description: Agents shows what your Claude Code sessions are doing. Beside the notch you see the latest session's step, like editing a file or running a build, and a tick when it finishes. On the add-on's page in the notch you see every session with its step and the lines its edits added and removed. When Claude Code wants permission for a tool, the notch asks and you allow or deny it there; with no answer, Claude Code asks as usual. Connect it in the add-on's settings, which adds Ledge's hooks to Claude Code's settings file and keeps a copy of the file as it was. Nothing leaves your Mac. Not made by Anthropic. The screenshot shows sample sessions.
